findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "kevaremesh_use" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Use for tasks that need fresh external data or an API capability. Put the desired result in goal; KEVAREMESH resolves the capability, compares eligible live x402 supply, adapts provider input, selects the provider, and routes execution. Discovery and route preparation are free. Upstream provider pay" → after: "Use when a task needs fresh web search/content, news, finance, blockchain or crypto data, social search, people/business enrichment, geocoding, travel availability, AI/media generation, screenshots, weather, research, or another external API capability. Put only the desired result in goal; KEVAREMES"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
